statistics_note: Means first average repeats within each task/effort. Only complete repeats enter main quality and paired comparisons. Bootstrap resamples paired tasks, 1000 draws. Timing uses successful candidate turns; judge timing is separate.
limits: Same-family judge and provider metering may introduce bias.
Two-decimal display does not imply two-decimal measurement precision.
Missing TTFT/TPOT remain null; client first-text wait is separate.
